verifications.claim: Crimson Desert is set to release globally on March 19, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Crimson Desert is due out March 19'; R2: 'set to release on PS5, Xbox, and PC on Thursday, March 19'; R3: 'launch... on March 19'; R5: 'release time is 3 PM PT / 6 PM ET on March 19, 2026'; R7: 'delayed... to Q1 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm March 19 (2026 context from imminent launch and prior delay to 2026) as global release date.

verifications.claim: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game from Pearl Abyss.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'open-world action adventure game... developer and publisher Pearl Abyss'; R2: 'open-world action-adventure game... Developed by Pearl Abyss'; R3: 'action-adventure game... Pearl Abyss'; R7: 'open-world action fantasy game... Pearl Abyss'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe it as open-world action-adventure by Pearl Abyss.

verifications.claim: Crimson Desert will be available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam/Epic.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S'; R2: 'PS5, Xbox... PC... Steam | Epic'; R3: 'all platforms'; R5: 'PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC'; R6: Steam page; R7: 'PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X and S'
verifications.reasoning: All listed platforms explicitly supported, including Steam and Epic for PC.

verifications.claim: Pre-orders for Crimson Desert are currently available.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'It’s available for preorder now (see it at Amazon)'

verifications.claim: Pre-loading for Crimson Desert begins around March 17-18, 2026, depending on the region.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'pre-load... began on March 17, exactly 48 hours before'; R5: 'pre-load 48 hours before... North America... March 17... Japan... March 18'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm pre-load starts 48 hours prior (March 17-18 by region).

verifications.claim: Crimson Desert was previously delayed to 2026 to allow for further development, according to IGN.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: IGN (R7) confirms delay to 2026 for development-related reasons (voiceovers, cert, prep); 'further development' aligns closely.
